enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do passado simples e do passado contínuo em inglês, com foco em prática controlada por meio de frases contextualizadas. Além disso, apresenta vocabulário relacionado a culinária, agricultura e negócios, incluindo traduções e definições claras.

vocabulary.definition: The middle of the day, usually around 12 PM.
examples: We had lunch at midday.
The sun is at its highest point at midday.

vocabulary.definition: To act as if something is true when it is not.
examples: She pretended to be asleep.
He pretends to understand the joke.

vocabulary.definition: To plan or aim to do something.
examples: I intend to travel next year.
She intends to finish her degree soon.

vocabulary.definition: A black or dark brown rock that is burned as a fuel.
examples: Coal is used in many industrial processes.
The coal-fired oven produces delicious pizzas.

vocabulary.definition: As much or as many as required.
examples: I have enough money to buy the ticket.
Is this jacket warm enough?

vocabulary.definition: Cheese that has been stored for a period of time to develop flavor.
examples: Aged cheese has a stronger taste.
I prefer mature cheese over fresh cheese.

vocabulary.definition: An oven that uses coal as fuel.
examples: The coal-fired oven is perfect for baking pizzas.
Coal-fired ovens are common in traditional bakeries.

vocabulary.definition: A sweet made from milk and sugar.
examples: Milk candy is popular in Brazil.
She prepared milk candy for dessert.

vocabulary.definition: A room where food is prepared and cooked.
examples: The kitchen is clean and organized.
She spent all day in the kitchen preparing meals.

vocabulary.definition: A device used for cooking, typically with burners or a flat surface.
examples: The stove is electric.
She cooked pasta on the stove.

vocabulary.definition: A compartment used for baking or roasting food.
examples: The cake is in the oven.
The oven temperature is set to 180 degrees.

vocabulary.definition: A thick, dark syrup made from sugarcane.
examples: Molasses is used in baking.
He added molasses to the bread dough.

vocabulary.definition: To cultivate plants for food.
examples: She grows vegetables in her garden.
They grow vegetables organically.

vocabulary.definition: A green fruit with a creamy texture.
examples: Avocados are healthy.
I made avocado toast for breakfast.

vocabulary.definition: Animal waste used as fertilizer.
examples: Farmers use manure to enrich the soil.
Manure is spread over the fields every spring.

vocabulary.definition: Decomposed organic material used as fertilizer.
examples: Composting is good for the environment.
We added compost to the garden soil.

vocabulary.definition: The average period a person is expected to live.
examples: Life expectancy has increased over the years.
The life expectancy in this country is high.

vocabulary.definition: No less than; at the minimum.
examples: You should sleep at least 7 hours a night.
At least 50 people attended the event.

vocabulary.definition: The period when one stops working permanently.
examples: She is planning for her retirement.
Retirement is a time to relax and enjoy life.

vocabulary.definition: Throughout the entire day.
examples: He worked all day long.
She listened to music all day long.

vocabulary.definition: A financial grant for education.
examples: She received a scholarship to study abroad.
Scholarships help students afford college.

vocabulary.definition: Working for oneself, not for an employer.
examples: She is self-employed and runs her own business.
Being self-employed gives you flexibility.

vocabulary.definition: Capturing attention or curiosity.
examples: This book is very interesting.
The lecture was interesting and engaging.

grammar.explanation: The simple past is used for completed actions in the past, while the past continuous describes ongoing actions in the past that were interrupted or happening simultaneously.
rules: Use the simple past for definite, completed actions: 'I ate breakfast.'
Use the past continuous for ongoing actions: 'I was eating breakfast when he called.'
Combine both tenses to describe an interruption: 'She was reading a book when the lights went out.'
examples: The baker dropped the tray while he was taking the fresh bread out of the oven.
Lucas was waiting for the bus when he saw a famous actor.
The students were whispering to each other when the teacher walked into the classroom.
commonMistakes: Using past continuous for completed actions: 'I was ate breakfast.' (Incorrect)
Forgetting the auxiliary verb 'was/were' in past continuous: 'He taking a nap.' (Incorrect)

expressions.usage: Used to describe activities that last the entire day.
examples: She worked all day long.
He stayed indoors all day long.

expressions.meaning: No less than; at the minimum.
expressions.usage: Used to express a minimum amount or requirement.
examples: You should drink at least 8 glasses of water a day.
At least 20 people showed up.

practiceQuestions.question: The baker / drop / the tray / while / he / take / the fresh bread / out of the oven.
practiceQuestions.answer: The baker dropped the tray while he was taking the fresh bread out of the oven.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence combines the simple past ('dropped') for the completed action and the past continuous ('was taking') for the ongoing action.

practiceQuestions.question: Lucas / wait / for the bus / when / he / see / a famous actor.
practiceQuestions.answer: Lucas was waiting for the bus when he saw a famous actor.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence uses the past continuous ('was waiting') for the ongoing action and the simple past ('saw') for the interruption.

culturalNotes: Coal-fired ovens are traditional in many cultures for baking bread and pizzas.
Milk candy is a popular dessert in Latin American countries, especially Brazil.
studyTips: Practice combining simple past and past continuous in sentences to describe interruptions.
Use flashcards to memorize new vocabulary and their translations.
Focus on pronunciation by listening to native speakers and repeating the words.
originalExamples: The baker dropped the tray while he was taking the fresh bread out of the oven. (O padeiro deixou cair a bandeja enquanto estava tirando o pão fresco do forno.)
Lucas was waiting for the bus when he saw a famous actor. (Lucas estava esperando o ônibus quando viu um ator famoso.)
The students were whispering to each other when the teacher walked into the classroom. (Os alunos estavam sussurrando entre si quando o professor entrou na sala.)

The project manager entered the room while the developers were debating the software architecture. (O gerente de projeto entrou na sala enquanto os desenvolvedores estavam debatendo a arquitetura do software.)
The marketing team was brainstorming new ideas when the fire alarm rang. (A equipe de marketing estava discutindo novas ideias quando o alarme de incêndio tocou.)
